V. 21.
N•t every one—That is, no one, that ſaith Lord, Lord— That ma•es a mere Profeſſion of Me and my Religion, ſhall enter—Whatever their falſe Teachers may aſſure them to the contrary: He th•• d••h the will of my Father—As I have now declared it. Obſerve: Every thing ſhort of this, is only ſaying Lord, Lord.
